labels.notes: Enhanced Chinese document about face and lower body recognition. OpenCV Haar cascade, AdaBoost ensemble classifier. Haar-like feature diagrams (edge, line, center-surround, diagonal). Clean typed text with clear diagrams. Good enhancement. Sparse bottom half.

Enhanced Chinese chemistry worksheet. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Problems 3-4: element symbol/name exercises (Ca, Mg, Cu, Cl, N, O, F, Ne, P, Ar, Fe, Ag, Hg, K, Al). Fill-in-the-blank format. Very sparse content. Clean enhancement but rotation degrades quality.

Enhanced Chinese scientific document. Climate models, CMIP6 sensitivity analysis, dark matter detection (WIMP-nucleon cross sections), ionization front models. Dense typed text with figure references [15-19]. Clean enhancement, good readability.

Enhanced Chinese chemistry exercise 练习1. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Physical vs chemical changes: glass melting, ice→water, ore crushing, gasoline evaporation, wax melting, tire explosion, gunpowder, iron rust, light bulb, CO2 reactions. Clean typed text. Rotation is main issue.

Enhanced Chinese chemistry notes about separation/purification methods. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Physical (filtration, evaporation, distillation, crystallization, sublimation) and chemical (precipitation, replacement, heating, decomposition). Very sparse content. Clean but rotated.

Enhanced Chinese math textbook. §1 Sets and Logic, 1.2 常用逻辑概念 (Common Logic Concepts). ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Propositions, true/false exercises about divisibility, triangles, angles. Clean typed text. Good enhancement but rotation reduces quality.

Enhanced Python SDE code. Second variation convergence plots, SDE trajectory generation with alpha/nu/sigma parameters. Dense monospace code with matplotlib plotting. Good enhancement, clean layout, readable code. Slightly faded gray text.

Enhanced Chinese linear algebra textbook. Problems 4-7: Elementary transformations, adjugate matrix (AB)*=B*A*, rank proofs r(A)=r(A^⊥), Kronecker delta, primitive roots. Dense mathematical content with matrices. Clean typed text, excellent enhancement. Best quality in this batch.

Enhanced Chinese chemistry exercises. ROTATED 90 degrees clockwise. Mars rover COS detection, sulfur compounds classification, valence identification (S, SO2, H2S, H2SO4), atomic group questions. Multiple choice with chemical formulas. Clean but rotated.

Enhanced Chinese I2S audio and DSP document, page 11. I2S timing diagram (DS-DI, SCLK, LRCK signals). Section 2.3 waveform generation (lookup table, Taylor series). Section 3.1 algorithm flow. IIR filter H(z) formula, sine approximation. Good technical content with diagrams.
